subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component callbacks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields should be public versus plugin-only?
rationale: The requested change creates a public inbound-context contract and exposes Discord identifiers plus callback data, so maintainers need to choose schema, compatibility shape, and trust boundary before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a documented bounded metadata envelope with originating message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields on plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic fallback messages.

options.title: Start With Sender And Message
options.body: Expose only clicker and originating message ids first, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a documented bounded metadata envelope with originating message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across Discord component wiring and typed plugin/channel boundary decisions near this contract.
